scripts.cleanTS: node -e "import('node:fs').then(fs => fs.rmSync('_ts', { recursive: true, force: true }))"
scripts.buildTS: npm run cleanTS && dotnet fable ../Src/Euclid.Kontur.fsproj --lang typescript --outDir ./_ts --configuration Release --run npm run checkTS
scripts.test: dotnet tool restore && npm run testJS && npm run testDb && npm run buildTS
